items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: On this most recent recording I called in Bobby Sanabria to lay some tracks.

ctx.x: No one ever says hey I think I’m a little too loud.

Yeah. On this most recent recording I called in Bobby Sanabria to lay some tracks. And Bobby is another phenomenal one. Wow. Wow. And then he’d come in, I gave him, I sent him the music ahead of time and he came in with his notes and the markings on the pages and then he goes in and he made his track. He came in and listened and said hmmm, and he could pinpoint certain things, and go back and bam, he’ll hit it and it’s done. And then he said all right now I hear this to go in and he’ll have another percussive…

All right. Let’s talk about the blues. Do you have a definition of your own, maybe I want to borrow it. In about a week I’m doing a little presentation about the blues for some group and I often struggle with a succinct but accurate definition of the blues.
